reply_text: I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-random. I confirmed that the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due on 3 April, not the date they posted in #central-team this morning. They said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A deadline is a signing date, not a money term, so it isn't a finance figure and repeating it in the channel was fine.
